name: rejoin_facing
_comment: T564 (chaos_36 replay): client_1 starts at spawn point 1 (another heading than spawn 0's), leaves (pause_quit, its mech a bot) and rejoins. The rejoiner rebuilds every mech from the late state (Arena._late_mech): it spawned them all at spawn 0's heading, so its own mech's body faced another way than the server's; the aim is absolute but body-local (V47), so its shots on the server went off by the difference until its next respawn (rot_local equal, rot_global apart). transform_desync: the rejoiner's own mech tracks the server's, rot_global included.
